annotations.title: How cases ended in one place

description: Every published figure for one place and kind of case: cases filed and closed, trials, plaintiff wins at trial, the share settled and days to closing, each with its label and source. Without a year: the latest year and multi-year figures.

case_type.description: A kind of case, e.g. "motor vehicle", "medical malpractice". Optional: all personal injury.

place.description: The nation, a state, a federal district court or a county, e.g. "California".
